briefing: Markets rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 1.9% and the S&P 500 up 1.2%, a clear risk-on session led by semiconductor, storage and AI-infrastructure names. Cash is limited at about $446, so we are making one small buy in NBIS, the only screened stock with full multi-signal confirmation including a volume surge, and holding all seven existing positions so their stop-losses and profit targets can work automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech and chip stocks, which pushes those prices up more than the overall market. Today's NASDAQ rising more than the S&P 500 is a classic example. Even on risk-on days, it is smart to buy only stocks that several signals agree on, rather than chasing everything that went up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，將資金轉投科技股、半導體股等較高風險、增長較快的資產，令這類股份升幅跑贏大市。今日納斯達克升幅高於標普500，正是典型例子。不過，即使市況偏向風險偏好，也應只揀選多項技術指標同時確認的股份，而非盲目追捧所有上升的股票。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks rose broadly today, with tech-heavy NASDAQ names leading the S&P 500, a typical sign that investors were willing to take on more risk. The gains were concentrated in chipmakers, memory and storage companies, and AI data-center infrastructure stocks, many of which pushed into or near overbought territory on their momentum indicators. No news headlines were provided in today's data, so this explanation is based only on price and sector behavior, not on specific reported catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股普遍造好，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數升幅跑贏標普500，反映投資者風險胃納明顯回升。升勢主要集中在半導體、記憶體及儲存板塊，以及AI數據中心基建相關股份，當中不少個股的動能指標已接近或進入超買區域。由於今日數據未附帶新聞標題，以上分析僅根據股價走勢及板塊表現，並非基於具體消息催化因素。

trades.reasoning: NBIS is the only candidate showing all four confirmation signals together (MACD crossover, rising histogram, price well above SMA-20, volume surge), but RSI sits right at 70, so conviction is medium rather than high.
